visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short black hair, wearing glasses and a black baseball cap, holds a wooden skewer with three brown, glistening fried dough balls coated in sesame seeds. He is standing outdoors on a sidewalk with leafy green trees in the background. A red shop sign with Chinese text is partially visible. (2) The camera moves closer to the man's face as he takes a large bite of the topmost fried ball. He chews with an exaggerated facial expression, looking upwards. A white and yellow emoji and subtitle appear on screen. The lighting is bright and natural daylight. (3) The scene cuts to a food preparation counter. A woman wearing a yellow apron over a white T-shirt is spreading minced meat filling onto long, flattened strips of dough. Nearby, a basket holds several golden-brown, circular fried pastries. The setting is a compact street-side food stall. (4) A close-up shot shows a large, round iron griddle where several spiral-shaped pastries are being fried in shallow oil. Metal tongs are used to flip and move the golden-brown dough. (5) The man is shown again outdoors, holding a half-eaten, flaky, golden-brown spiral pastry. He takes a bite, closing one eye as he chews. The background shows an urban street with power lines and a tree. He wears a grey sweatshirt. (6) Another man, also wearing a black cap and glasses, is seen tasting a piece of the pastry. He is positioned in front of a light-colored wall with trees behind him. He nods and speaks while chewing. (7) The video ends with shots of the shop's red banners displaying Chinese characters like 成都名小吃 and 糖油果子, along with a detailed price list on the wall.

It combines the creator's personal tasting reaction with footage of the cooking process to provide a comprehensive look at the street food experience.
